1	// Package ast defines AST node types for the mini FreeLang subset
2	package ast
3	
4	type NodeKind int
5	
6	const (
7		NodeProgram        NodeKind = iota
8		NodeLetDecl                 // let x = expr
9		NodeFnDecl                  // fn name(params) body
10		NodeIfStmt                  // if cond { body }
11		NodeForStmt                 // for i in range { body }
12		NodeBinaryExpr              // a + b, a * b
13		NodeCallExpr                // fn(args)
14		NodeIdent                   // 변수 참조
15		NodeIntLit                  // 정수 리터럴
16		NodeReturn                  // return expr
17		NodeBlockStmt               // { statements }
18		NodeRangeExpr               // 0..10
19		NodeStructDecl              // struct Name { fields }
20		NodeFieldDecl               // fieldName: Type
21		NodeFieldAccess             // expr.field
22		NodeTypeAnnotation          // 타입 표현식 (int, bool, Point)
23		NodeBoolLit                 // true / false 리터럴
24		NodeStringLit               // "hello" 문자열 리터럴
25		NodeStructLit               // Point{x: 1, y: 2} 구조체 초기화
26	)

1	// Package lexer implements a tokenizer for mini FreeLang
2	package lexer
3	
4	import (
5		"unicode"
6	
7		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ast"
8	)
9	
10	type Lexer struct {
11		input        string
12		pos          int    // current position
13		readPos      int    // next reading position
14		ch           byte   // current character
15		line         int
16		col          int
17		startCol     int
18		prevLineLen  int
19	}
20	
21	// New creates a new lexer for the input string
22	func New(input string) *Lexer {
23		l := &Lexer{
24			input: input,
25			line:  1,
26			col:   0,
27		}
28		l.readChar()
29		return l
30	}
31	
32	func (l *Lexer) readChar() {
33		if l.readPos >= len(l.input) {
34			l.ch = 0 // EOF
35		} else {
36			l.ch = l.input[l.readPos]
37		}
38	
39		if l.ch == '\n' {
40			l.prevLineLen = l.col
41			l.line++
42			l.col = 0
43		} else {
44			l.col++
45		}
46	
47		l.pos = l.readPos
48		l.readPos++
49	}
50	
51	func (l *Lexer) peekChar() byte {
52		if l.readPos >= len(l.input) {
53			return 0
54		}
55		return l.input[l.readPos]
56	}
57	
58	func (l *Lexer) skipWhitespace() {
59		for l.ch == ' ' || l.ch == '\t' || l.ch == '\n' || l.ch == '\r' {
60			l.readChar()
61		}
62	}
63	
64	func (l *Lexer) readIdent() string {
65		startPos := l.pos
66		for isLetter(l.ch) || isDigit(l.ch) || l.ch == '_' {
67			l.readChar()
68		}
69		return l.input[startPos:l.pos]
70	}
71	
72	func (l *Lexer) readNumber() string {
73		startPos := l.pos
74		for isDigit(l.ch) {
75			l.readChar()
76		}
77		return l.input[startPos:l.pos]
78	}
79	
80	func (l *Lexer) NextToken() ast.Token {
81		l.skipWhitespace()
82	
83		startCol := l.col
84		startLine := l.line
85	
86		var tok ast.Token
87		tok.Line = startLine
88		tok.Col = startCol
89	
90		switch l.ch {
91		case 0:
92			tok.Type = ast.TokenEOF
93			tok.Value = ""
94		case '+':
95			tok.Type = ast.TokenPlus
96			tok.Value = "+"
97			l.readChar()
98		case '-':
99			tok.Type = ast.TokenMinus
100			tok.Value = "-"
101			l.readChar()
102		case '*':
103			tok.Type = ast.TokenStar
104			tok.Value = "*"
105			l.readChar()
106		case '/':
107			tok.Type = ast.TokenSlash
108			tok.Value = "/"
109			l.readChar()
110		case '=':
111			if l.peekChar() == '=' {
112				l.readChar()
113				tok.Type = ast.TokenEq
114				tok.Value = "=="
115				l.readChar()
116			} else {
117				tok.Type = ast.TokenAssign
118				tok.Value = "="
119				l.readChar()
120			}
121		case '!':
122			if l.peekChar() == '=' {
123				l.readChar()
124				tok.Type = ast.TokenNe
125				tok.Value = "!="
126				l.readChar()
127			} else {
128				// Single ! not supported for now
129				l.readChar()
130				return l.NextToken()
131			}
132		case '<':
133			if l.peekChar() == '=' {
134				l.readChar()
135				tok.Type = ast.TokenLe
136				tok.Value = "<="
137				l.readChar()
138			} else {
139				tok.Type = ast.TokenLt
140				tok.Value = "<"
141				l.readChar()
142			}
143		case '>':
144			if l.peekChar() == '=' {
145				l.readChar()
146				tok.Type = ast.TokenGe
147				tok.Value = ">="
148				l.readChar()
149			} else {
150				tok.Type = ast.TokenGt
151				tok.Value = ">"
152				l.readChar()
153			}
154		case '.':
155			if l.peekChar() == '.' {
156				l.readChar()
157				tok.Type = ast.TokenDotDot
158				tok.Value = ".."
159				l.readChar()
160			} else {
161				tok.Type = ast.TokenDot
162				tok.Value = "."
163				l.readChar()
164			}
165		case '(':
166			tok.Type = ast.TokenLParen
167			tok.Value = "("
168			l.readChar()
169		case ')':
170			tok.Type = ast.TokenRParen
171			tok.Value = ")"
172			l.readChar()
173		case '{':
174			tok.Type = ast.TokenLBrace
175			tok.Value = "{"
176			l.readChar()
177		case '}':
178			tok.Type = ast.TokenRBrace
179			tok.Value = "}"
180			l.readChar()
181		case ',':
182			tok.Type = ast.TokenComma
183			tok.Value = ","
184			l.readChar()
185		case ':':
186			tok.Type = ast.TokenColon
187			tok.Value = ":"
188			l.readChar()
189		case ';':
190			tok.Type = ast.TokenSemicolon
191			tok.Value = ";"
192			l.readChar()
193		case '"':
194			// String literal: "hello"
195			l.readChar() // consume opening "
196			startPos := l.pos
197			for l.ch != '"' && l.ch != 0 {
198				l.readChar()
199			}
200			tok.Value = l.input[startPos:l.pos]
201			tok.Type = ast.TokenString
202			if l.ch == '"' {
203				l.readChar() // consume closing "
204			}
205		default:
206			if isLetter(l.ch) {
207				ident := l.readIdent()
208				tok.Type = lookupKeyword(ident)
209				tok.Value = ident
210			} else if isDigit(l.ch) {
211				num := l.readNumber()
212				tok.Type = ast.TokenInt
213				tok.Value = num
214			} else {
215				l.readChar()
216				return l.NextToken()
217			}
218		}
219	
220		return tok
221	}
222	
223	func isLetter(ch byte) bool {
224		return unicode.IsLetter(rune(ch))
225	}
226	
227	func isDigit(ch byte) bool {
228		return unicode.IsDigit(rune(ch))
229	}
230	
231	func lookupKeyword(ident string) ast.TokenType {
232		switch ident {
233		case "let":
234			return ast.TokenLet
235		case "fn":
236			return ast.TokenFn
237		case "if":
238			return ast.TokenIf
239		case "for":
240			return ast.TokenFor
241		case "in":
242			return ast.TokenIn
243		case "return":
244			return ast.TokenReturn
245		case "struct":
246			return ast.TokenStruct
247		case "true":
248			return ast.TokenTrue
249		case "false":
250			return ast.TokenFalse
251		case "else":
252			return ast.TokenElse
253		default:
254			return ast.TokenIdent
255		}
256	}
257

1	// Package ir defines intermediate representation for optimized AST
2	package ir
3	
4	// Opcode represents an intermediate representation instruction operation
5	type Opcode int
6	
7	const (
8		OpNoop Opcode = iota
9		OpConst
10		OpCopy
11		OpAdd
12		OpSub
13		OpMul
14		OpDiv
15		OpEq
16		OpNe
17		OpLt
18		OpGt
19		OpLe
20		OpGe
21		OpLabel
22		OpJump
23		OpJumpIf
24		OpJumpIfFalse
25		OpCall
26		OpParam
27		OpReturn
28		OpEnter
29		OpLeave
30		OpStructDef
31		OpFieldLoad
32		OpFieldStore
33		OpSyscall
34	)
35	
36	// Operand represents a value in an instruction (register, immediate, or label)
37	type Operand struct {
38		IsTemp  bool   // true if this is a temporary (t0, t1, ...)
39		Name    string // variable name or temp name
40		IsImm   bool   // true if this is an immediate integer
41		ImmVal  int64  // immediate value
42		IsLabel bool   // true if this is a label reference
43		IsStr   bool   // true if this is an immediate string
44		SVal    string // string value
45		IsBool  bool   // true if this is an immediate bool
46		BVal    bool   // bool value
47	}
48	
49	// Instruction is a three-address code instruction
50	type Instruction struct {
51		Op    Opcode
52		Dest  Operand
53		Src1  Operand
54		Src2  Operand
55		Label string // for OpLabel, OpJump, OpJumpIf, OpJumpIfFalse
56		Fn    string // for OpCall, OpEnter, OpLeave
57		Line  int    // source line number
58	}
59	
60	// Function represents a function in IR
61	type Function struct {
62		Name   string
63		Params []string
64		Body   []Instruction
65	}
66	
67	// Program represents a complete program in IR
68	type Program struct {
69		Functions []Function
70		Main      []Instruction
71	}
72	
73	// ByteSize returns the estimated byte size of the program (4 bytes per instruction)
74	func (p *Program) ByteSize() int {
75		count := len(p.Main)
76		for _, fn := range p.Functions {
77			count += len(fn.Body)
78		}
79		return count * 4
80	}
81

1	// Package codegen converts IR to pseudo-assembly text
2	package codegen
3	
4	import (
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"
7	
8		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ir"
9	)
10	
11	// Result contains generated code and metrics
12	type Result struct {
13		Code      string // Generated pseudo-assembly text
14		ByteSize  int    // Length of generated code in bytes
15		LineCount int    // Number of lines in output
16	}
17	
18	// CodeGen generates pseudo-assembly from IR
19	type CodeGen struct {
20		code      strings.Builder
21		lineCount int
22	}
23	
24	// New creates a new code generator
25	func New() *CodeGen {
26		return &CodeGen{
27			lineCount: 0,
28		}
29	}
30	
31	// Generate converts IR program to pseudo-assembly
32	func (cg *CodeGen) Generate(prog *ir.Program) Result {
33		cg.code.Reset()
34		cg.lineCount = 0
35	
36		// Generate functions
37		for _, fn := range prog.Functions {
38			cg.generateFunction(fn)
39		}
40	
41		// Generate main
42		if len(prog.Main) > 0 {
43			cg.writeLine("; === main ===")
44			cg.generateInstructions(prog.Main)
45		}
46	
47		code := cg.code.String()
48		return Result{
49			Code:      code,
50			ByteSize:  len(code),
51			LineCount: cg.lineCount,
52		}
53	}
54	
55	// generateFunction generates code for a single function
56	func (cg *CodeGen) generateFunction(fn ir.Function) {
57		cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("; === function %s ===", fn.Name))
58		cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("ENTER %s", fn.Name))
59	
60		cg.generateInstructions(fn.Body)
61	
62		// Ensure LEAVE is present
63		if len(fn.Body) == 0 || fn.Body[len(fn.Body)-1].Op != ir.OpLeave {
64			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("LEAVE %s", fn.Name))
65		}
66	
67		cg.writeLine("")
68	}
69	
70	// generateInstructions generates code for a list of instructions
71	func (cg *CodeGen) generateInstructions(instrs []ir.Instruction) {
72		for _, instr := range instrs {
73			cg.generateInstruction(instr)
74		}
75	}
76	
77	// generateInstruction generates code for a single instruction
78	func (cg *CodeGen) generateInstruction(instr ir.Instruction) {
79		switch instr.Op {
80		case ir.OpConst:
81			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  LOAD %s, #%d", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), instr.Src1.ImmVal))
82	
83		case ir.OpCopy:
84			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  COPY %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
85	
86		case ir.OpAdd:
87			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  ADD %s, %s, %s",
88				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
89				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
90				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
91	
92		case ir.OpSub:
93			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  SUB %s, %s, %s",
94				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
95				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
96				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
97	
98		case ir.OpMul:
99			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  MUL %s, %s, %s",
100				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
101				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
102				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
103	
104		case ir.OpDiv:
105			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  DIV %s, %s, %s",
106				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
107				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
108				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
109	
110		case ir.OpEq:
111			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, == %s",
112				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
113				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
114				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
115	
116		case ir.OpNe:
117			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, != %s",
118				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
119				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
120				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
121	
122		case ir.OpLt:
123			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, < %s",
124				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
125				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
126				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
127	
128		case ir.OpGt:
129			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, > %s",
130				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
131				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
132				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
133	
134		case ir.OpLe:
135			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, <= %s",
136				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
137				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
138				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
139	
140		case ir.OpGe:
141			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CMP %s, %s, >= %s",
142				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
143				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
144				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
145	
146		case ir.OpLabel:
147			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("%s:", instr.Label))
148	
149		case ir.OpJump:
150			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JUMP %s", instr.Label))
151	
152		case ir.OpJumpIf:
153			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JIT %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1), instr.Label))
154	
155		case ir.OpJumpIfFalse:
156			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  JLF %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1), instr.Label))
157	
158		case ir.OpCall:
159			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  CALL %s, %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest), instr.Fn))
160	
161		case ir.OpParam:
162			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  PARAM %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
163	
164		case ir.OpReturn:
165			if instr.Src1.Name != "" || instr.Src1.IsImm {
166				cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  RET %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1)))
167			} else {
168				cg.writeLine("  RET")
169			}
170	
171		case ir.OpEnter:
172			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("ENTER %s", instr.Fn))
173	
174		case ir.OpLeave:
175			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("LEAVE %s", instr.Fn))
176	
177		case ir.OpStructDef:
178			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("; STRUCT %s size=%d", instr.Fn, instr.Src1.ImmVal))
179	
180		case ir.OpFieldLoad:
181			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  LOAD %s, [%s+%d]",
182				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
183				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src1),
184				instr.Src2.ImmVal))
185	
186		case ir.OpFieldStore:
187			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  STORE [%s+%d], %s",
188				cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest),
189				instr.Src1.ImmVal,
190				cg.formatOperand(instr.Src2)))
191	
192		case ir.OpSyscall:
193			cg.writeLine(fmt.Sprintf("  SVC %s", cg.formatOperand(instr.Dest)))
194	
195		case ir.OpNoop:
196			// Skip noop instructions
197		}
198	}
199	
200	// formatOperand converts an operand to text representation
201	func (cg *CodeGen) formatOperand(op ir.Operand) string {
202		if op.IsImm {
203			return fmt.Sprintf("#%d", op.ImmVal)
204		}
205		if op.IsLabel {
206			return op.Name
207		}
208		return op.Name
209	}
210	
211	// writeLine appends a line to the output
212	func (cg *CodeGen) writeLine(line string) {
213		cg.code.WriteString(line)
214		cg.code.WriteString("\n")
215		cg.lineCount++
216	}
217

3	import (
4		"fmt"
5	
6		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/builtin"
7		"github.com/user/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ir"
8	)
9	
10	// VM represents the FreeLang virtual machine
11	type VM struct {
12		program    *ir.Program
13		fnIndex    map[string]*ir.Function
14		callStack  []*CallFrame
15		paramQueue []Value
16		globals    map[string]Value
17	}
18	
19	// New creates a new VM for the given IR program
20	func New(prog *ir.Program) *VM {
21		vm := &VM{
22			program:    prog,
23			fnIndex:    make(map[string]*ir.Function),
24			callStack:  make([]*CallFrame, 0),
25			paramQueue: make([]Value, 0),
26			globals:    make(map[string]Value),
27		}
28	
29		// Build function index
30		for i := range prog.Functions {
31			vm.fnIndex[prog.Functions[i].Name] = &prog.Functions[i]
32		}
33	
34		return vm
35	}
36	
37	// Run executes the program and returns the result
38	func (vm *VM) Run() (Value, error) {
39		// Build label map for main
40		labelMap := buildLabelMap(vm.program.Main)
41	
42		// Execute main instructions
43		_, err := vm.execInstrs(vm.program.Main, labelMap, nil)
44		if err != nil {
45			return NilVal(), err
46		}
47	
48		return NilVal(), nil
49	}
50	
51	// DumpGlobals returns the global variables (for testing)
52	func (vm *VM) DumpGlobals() map[string]Value {
53		return vm.globals
54	}
55	
56	// execInstrs executes a sequence of instructions and returns the result
57	func (vm *VM) execInstrs(instrs []ir.Instruction, labelMap map[string]int, frame *CallFrame) (Value, error) {
58		pc := 0
59		var result Value
60	
61		for pc < len(instrs) {
62			instr := instrs[pc]
63			pc++
64	
65			switch instr.Op {
66			case ir.OpNoop:
67				// No operation
68	
69			case ir.OpConst:
70				// Load constant
71				if instr.Src1.IsImm {
72					result = IntVal(instr.Src1.ImmVal)
73					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
74				}
75	
76			case ir.OpCopy:
77				// Copy value
78				src := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
79				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, src, frame)
80	
81			case ir.OpAdd, ir.OpSub, ir.OpMul, ir.OpDiv:
82				left := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
83				right := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src2, frame)
84	
85				// String concatenation
86				if instr.Op == ir.OpAdd && left.Kind == KindString && right.Kind == KindString {
87					result = StringVal(left.SVal + right.SVal)
88					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
89					break
90				}
91	
92				// Integer arithmetic
93				if left.Kind != KindInt || right.Kind != KindInt {
94					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("arithmetic operands must be int")
95				}
96	
97				var resultVal int64
98				switch instr.Op {
99				case ir.OpAdd:
100					resultVal = left.IVal + right.IVal
101				case ir.OpSub:
102					resultVal = left.IVal - right.IVal
103				case ir.OpMul:
104					resultVal = left.IVal * right.IVal
105				case ir.OpDiv:
106					if right.IVal == 0 {
107						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("division by zero")
108					}
109					resultVal = left.IVal / right.IVal
110				}
111				result = IntVal(resultVal)
112				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
113	
114			case ir.OpEq, ir.OpNe, ir.OpLt, ir.OpGt, ir.OpLe, ir.OpGe:
115				left := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
116				right := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src2, frame)
117	
118				var cmpResult bool
119	
120				// String comparison
121				if left.Kind == KindString && right.Kind == KindString {
122					switch instr.Op {
123					case ir.OpEq:
124						cmpResult = left.SVal == right.SVal
125					case ir.OpNe:
126						cmpResult = left.SVal != right.SVal
127					case ir.OpLt:
128						cmpResult = left.SVal < right.SVal
129					case ir.OpGt:
130						cmpResult = left.SVal > right.SVal
131					case ir.OpLe:
132						cmpResult = left.SVal <= right.SVal
133					case ir.OpGe:
134						cmpResult = left.SVal >= right.SVal
135					}
136					result = BoolVal(cmpResult)
137					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
138					break
139				}
140	
141				// Bool comparison
142				if left.Kind == KindBool && right.Kind == KindBool {
143					switch instr.Op {
144					case ir.OpEq:
145						cmpResult = left.BVal == right.BVal
146					case ir.OpNe:
147						cmpResult = left.BVal != right.BVal
148					default:
149						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("invalid comparison operator for bool")
150					}
151					result = BoolVal(cmpResult)
152					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
153					break
154				}
155	
156				// Integer comparison (default)
157				if left.Kind != KindInt || right.Kind != KindInt {
158					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("comparison operands must be same type (int, string, or bool)")
159				}
160	
161				switch instr.Op {
162				case ir.OpEq:
163					cmpResult = left.IVal == right.IVal
164				case ir.OpNe:
165					cmpResult = left.IVal != right.IVal
166				case ir.OpLt:
167					cmpResult = left.IVal < right.IVal
168				case ir.OpGt:
169					cmpResult = left.IVal > right.IVal
170				case ir.OpLe:
171					cmpResult = left.IVal <= right.IVal
172				case ir.OpGe:
173					cmpResult = left.IVal >= right.IVal
174				}
175				result = BoolVal(cmpResult)
176				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, result, frame)
177	
178			case ir.OpLabel:
179				// Label definition (no-op, already in labelMap)
180	
181			case ir.OpJump:
182				if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
183					pc = idx
184				} else {
185					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
186				}
187	
188			case ir.OpJumpIf:
189				condition := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
190				if condition.Truthy() {
191					if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
192						pc = idx
193					} else {
194						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
195					}
196				}
197	
198			case ir.OpJumpIfFalse:
199				condition := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
200				if !condition.Truthy() {
201					if idx, ok := labelMap[instr.Label]; ok {
202						pc = idx
203					} else {
204						return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined label: %s", instr.Label)
205					}
206				}
207	
208			case ir.OpParam:
209				arg := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
210				vm.paramQueue = append(vm.paramQueue, arg)
211	
212			case ir.OpCall:
213				args := vm.drainParamQueue()
214				retVal, err := vm.callFunction(instr.Fn, args)
215				if err != nil {
216					return NilVal(), err
217				}
218				vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, retVal, frame)
219	
220			case ir.OpReturn:
221				if instr.Src1.IsImm || instr.Src1.IsStr || instr.Src1.IsBool || instr.Src1.Name != "" {
222					return vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame), nil
223				}
224				return NilVal(), nil
225	
226			case ir.OpEnter, ir.OpLeave:
227				// No-op (callFunction handles frame management)
228	
229			case ir.OpStructDef:
230				// No-op (type definition, no runtime effect)
231	
232			case ir.OpFieldLoad:
233				obj := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
234				if obj.Kind != KindStruct {
235					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("field access on non-struct")
236				}
237				offset := instr.Src2.ImmVal / 8
238				fieldKey := fmt.Sprintf("f%d", offset)
239				if val, ok := obj.Fields[fieldKey]; ok {
240					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, val, frame)
241				} else {
242					vm.storeResult(instr.Dest, NilVal(), frame)
243				}
244	
245			case ir.OpFieldStore:
246				obj := vm.loadOperand(instr.Src1, frame)
247				if obj.Kind != KindStruct {
248					return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("field store on non-struct")
249				}
250				offset := instr.Src2.ImmVal / 8
251				fieldKey := fmt.Sprintf("f%d", offset)
252				value := vm.loadOperand(instr.Dest, frame)
253				obj.Fields[fieldKey] = value
254				if frame != nil {
255					frame.Set(instr.Src1.Name, obj)
256				} else {
257					vm.globals[instr.Src1.Name] = obj
258				}
259	
260			case ir.OpSyscall:
261				// No-op (not implemented)
262	
263			default:
264				return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("unknown opcode: %v", instr.Op)
265			}
266		}
267	
268		return result, nil
269	}
270	
271	// callFunction calls either a builtin or user-defined function
272	func (vm *VM) callFunction(name string, args []Value) (Value, error) {
273		// Check for builtin function
274		if builtin.IsBuiltin(name) {
275			def, _ := builtin.Lookup(name)
276			rawArgs := make([]interface{}, len(args))
277			for i, a := range args {
278				rawArgs[i] = a.ToInterface()
279			}
280			result := def.Impl(rawArgs...)
281			return FromInterface(result), nil
282		}
283	
284		// Check for user-defined function
285		fn, ok := vm.fnIndex[name]
286		if !ok {
287			return NilVal(), fmt.Errorf("undefined function: %s", name)
288		}
289	
290		// Create new frame and push to call stack
291		newFrame := NewFrame(fn.Name, fn.Params, args)
292		vm.callStack = append(vm.callStack, newFrame)
293		defer func() {
294			vm.callStack = vm.callStack[:len(vm.callStack)-1]
295		}()
296	
297		// Build label map for function body
298		labelMap := buildLabelMap(fn.Body)
299	
300		// Execute function body
301		retVal, err := vm.execInstrs(fn.Body, labelMap, newFrame)
302		if err != nil {
303			return NilVal(), err
304		}
305	
306		return retVal, nil
307	}
308	
309	// loadOperand loads a value from an operand
310	func (vm *VM) loadOperand(op ir.Operand, frame *CallFrame) Value {
311		// Immediate integer value
312		if op.IsImm {
313			return IntVal(op.ImmVal)
314		}
315	
316		// Immediate string value
317		if op.IsStr {
318			return StringVal(op.SVal)
319		}
320	
321		// Immediate bool value
322		if op.IsBool {
323			return BoolVal(op.BVal)
324		}
325	
326		// Named value (variable or temporary)
327		if op.Name != "" {
328			// Try frame first (if in function)
329			if frame != nil {
330				if v, ok := frame.Get(op.Name); ok {
331					return v
332				}
333			}
334	
335			// Try globals
336			if v, ok := vm.globals[op.Name]; ok {
337				return v
338			}
339	
340			return NilVal()
341		}
342	
343		return NilVal()
344	}
345	
346	// storeResult stores a value to a destination operand
347	func (vm *VM) storeResult(dest ir.Operand, v Value, frame *CallFrame) {
348		if dest.Name == "" {
349			return
350		}
351	
352		// Store in frame (if in function)
353		if frame != nil {
354			frame.Set(dest.Name, v)
355		} else {
356			// Store in globals
357			vm.globals[dest.Name] = v
358		}
359	}
360	
361	// buildLabelMap builds a map from label names to instruction indices
362	func buildLabelMap(instrs []ir.Instruction) map[string]int {
363		m := make(map[string]int)
364		for i, instr := range instrs {
365			if instr.Op == ir.OpLabel {
366				m[instr.Label] = i
367			}
368		}
369		return m
370	}
371	
372	// drainParamQueue returns and clears the parameter queue
373	func (vm *VM) drainParamQueue() []Value {
374		args := make([]Value, len(vm.paramQueue))
375		copy(args, vm.paramQueue)
376		vm.paramQueue = vm.paramQueue[:0]
377		return args
378	}

모든 파일을 충분히 분석했습니다. 다음은 Phase 5 Array 지원 구현에 필요한 전체 분석 결과입니다.

---

## Phase 5 Array 지원 구현 분석 보고서

---

### 1. 현재 NodeKind 목록

`/data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ast/nodes.go` (lines 6-26)에 정의된 18개:

| NodeKind | 설명 |
|---|---|
| NodeProgram | 프로그램 루트 |
| NodeLetDecl | `let x = expr` |
| NodeFnDecl | `fn name(params) body` |
| NodeIfStmt | `if cond { body }` |
| NodeForStmt | `for i in range { body }` |
| NodeBinaryExpr | `a + b` 등 이항 연산 |
| NodeCallExpr | `fn(args)` 함수 호출 |
| NodeIdent | 변수 참조 |
| NodeIntLit | 정수 리터럴 |
| NodeReturn | `return expr` |
| NodeBlockStmt | `{ statements }` |
| NodeRangeExpr | `0..10` |
| NodeStructDecl | `struct Name { fields }` |
| NodeFieldDecl | `fieldName: Type` |
| NodeFieldAccess | `expr.field` |
| NodeTypeAnnotation | 타입 표현식 |
| NodeBoolLit | `true` / `false` |
| NodeStringLit | `"hello"` |
| NodeStructLit | `Point{x: 1, y: 2}` |

**추가 필요:** `NodeArrayLit` (리터럴), `NodeIndexExpr` (인덱싱 `arr[i]`)

---

### 2. Lexer에 `[`, `]` 처리가 있는가?

**없음.** `lexer.go`의 `NextToken()` switch문에 `[`와 `]` case가 전혀 없습니다. `default` 분기에서 미지원 문자를 조용히 skip (`l.readChar(); return l.NextToken()`)하도록 되어 있어 현재는 무시됩니다.

`ast/nodes.go`의 TokenType 상수 목록에도 `TokenLBracket`, `TokenRBracket`이 없습니다.

**추가 필요 위치:**
- `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/ast/nodes.go` - `TokenLBracket`, `TokenRBracket` 상수 추가
- `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/lexer/lexer.go` - `case '['`, `case ']'` 처리 추가

---

### 3. value.go에 KindArray가 이미 있는가?

**이미 완전히 구현되어 있습니다.**

`/data/data/com.termux/files/home/projects/freelang-evolving-compiler/internal/runtime/value.go`에:
- `KindArray` (line 15) - ValueKind 상수
- `Elems []Value` (line 26) - Value 구조체 필드
- `ArrayVal(elems []Value) Value` (line 49-51) - 생성자
- `Truthy()`, `String()`, `ToInterface()`, `FromInterface()` 모두 KindArray 분기 처리 완료

런타임 레이어는 Array를 이미 지원하므로 **수정 불필요**입니다.

---

### 4. Parser의 prefix/infix expression 처리 방식

Pratt Parser 방식으로 구현되어 있습니다.

**핵심 구조** (`parser.go` lines 341-507):
- `parseExpression(prec int)` - precedence climbing으로 표현식 파싱
- `parsePrimary()` - prefix 처리 (정수, 문자열, bool, 식별자, 괄호)
- `parseInfix(left)` - infix 처리 (이항 연산, `.` 필드 접근, 함수 호출)
- `precedence(tok)` - 토큰별 우선순위 테이블

**Array 추가 시 수정 포인트:**
- `parsePrimary()` - `case ast.TokenLBracket:` 추가로 `[1, 2, 3]` 리터럴 파싱 (새 함수 `parseArrayLit()`)
- `parseInfix()` - `case ast.TokenLBracket:` 추가로 `arr[i]` 인덱스 접근 파싱 (새 함수 `parseIndexExpr()`)
- `precedence()` - `TokenLBracket`에 높은 우선순위(6 등) 부여 (`.` dot보다 높거나 같게)

---

### 5. 현재 opcode 중 배열 관련이 있는가?

**없습니다.** `ir.go` (lines 7-34)의 전체 opcode 목록:

```
OpNoop, OpConst, OpCopy, OpAdd, OpSub, OpMul, OpDiv,
OpEq, OpNe, OpLt, OpGt, OpLe, OpGe,
OpLabel, OpJump, OpJumpIf, OpJumpIfFalse,
OpCall, OpParam, OpReturn, OpEnter, OpLeave,
OpStructDef, OpFieldLoad, OpFieldStore, OpSyscall
```

배열 관련 opcode가 전혀 없습니다.

**추가 필요한 opcode:**
- `OpArrayNew` - `[e1, e2, e3]` 배열 생성 (`Src1.ImmVal`에 원소 개수)
- `OpArrayLoad` - `arr[i]` 인덱스 읽기
- `OpArrayStore` - `arr[i] = v` 인덱스 쓰기 (선택)
- `OpArrayLen` - `len(arr)` (선택, builtin으로 대체 가능)

---

### 6. 새로운 opcode 추가 시 수정해야 하는 파일 목록

opcode를 하나 추가하면 파이프라인 전체에서 수정이 필요합니다:

| 파일 | 수정 내용 |
|---|---|
| `internal/ast/nodes.go` | `TokenLBracket`, `TokenRBracket`, `NodeArrayLit`, `NodeIndexExpr` 추가 |
| `internal/lexer/lexer.go` | `[`, `]` 토큰화 처리 추가 |
| `internal/parser/parser.go` | `parsePrimary`에 배열 리터럴, `parseInfix`에 인덱스 접근 추가 |
| `internal/ir/ir.go` | `OpArrayNew`, `OpArrayLoad`, `OpArrayStore` 상수 추가 |
| `internal/ir/generator.go` | `genExpr`의 switch에 `NodeArrayLit`, `NodeIndexExpr` case 추가, 대응 gen 함수 구현 |
| `internal/runtime/vm.go` | `execInstrs`의 switch에 새 opcode case 추가 (`KindArray` 처리) |
| `internal/codegen/codegen.go` | `generateInstruction`의 switch에 새 opcode 텍스트 출력 추가 |

`value.go`와 `frame.go`는 수정 불필요입니다. VM의 `loadOperand` / `storeResult`는 `Value` 타입을 그대로 다루므로 Array도 자동으로 처리됩니다.
